english.title: Provide false information in notification to police under domestic abuse protection order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been made the subject of a domestic abuse protection order by **(..SPECIFY COURT NAME..) on **(..SPECIFY COURT DATE..), in purported compliance with the notification requirements of section 41 of the Domestic Abuse Act 2021, provided information, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE INFORMATION..), which you knew to be false

english.notes:
(i) This offence only applies in relation to domestic abuse protection orders (DAPOs) made within pilot areas, in the specified period -
(a) in the London boroughs of Bromley, Croydon and Sutton and the Metropolitan District of Greater Manchester for the period beginning with 27th November 2024, see the Domestic Abuse Act 2021 (Commencement No. 6 and Saving Provisions) Regulations 2024;
(b) in the non-metropolitan county of Cleveland for the period beginning with 5th March 2025, see the Domestic Abuse Act 2021 (Commencement No. 7 and Saving Provisions) Regulations 2025; and (c) in the non-metropolitan districts of Hartlepool, Middlesborough, Redcar and Cleveland and Stockton-on-Tees for the period beginning with 11th March 2025, see the Domestic Abuse Act 2021 (Commencement No. 8 and Saving Provisions) Regulations 2025.
The pilot ends on the 26th November 2025.
(ii) For further details on the pilot see the notes on section 27 of the Domestic Abuse Act 2021.
(iii) Section 41(8) and (9) of the Domestic Abuse Act 2021 aim to avoid unnecessary duplication as long as notification requirements, e.g. for certain sex offenders or persons subject to a stalking protection order, apply under other provisions.(iv) See section 42 for how to notify the police.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or fine.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and/or fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction depends on the general limit in a magistrates’ court and may be 6 or 12 months depending on the date of conviction, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.
